name: Dare County, NC
findings: Dare County has 102 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dare County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
